title: Design decisions
summary: Rationale record for the LangGraph research agent: graph routing, memory retrieval, cost caps, storage backends, reliability, evals, and packaging.
notes: Filename/path give no type signal (docs/DESIGN.md). Content is prose-heavy rationale with no frontmatter, no Status field, and no Context/Decision/Consequences structure, so it lands as DOC. However it is de-facto ADR content: roughly 23 discrete architectural decisions, each stated as a choice plus the rejected alternative and its consequence (e.g. deterministic Python routing over an LLM router; critic split from writer; sessions in SQLite rather than LangGraph's checkpointer; one DATABASE_URL over three backend flags; retries at the node boundary; judge on a stronger model than the pipeline). Recommend the synthesizer treat these as decision candidates rather than context-only, and consider splitting them into numbered ADRs. Not marked locked: no Accepted status anywhere, and the doc is a single multi-decision narrative rather than one decision record. Hash suffix in the filename is a placeholder, not a real SHA-256 of the source path -- this agent has no Bash or hashing tool available.
decision_candidates: Routing is a deterministic Python state machine, not an LLM prompt
Critic is a separate node with its own rubric and the notes as sole source of truth
All loops bounded; forced stops reported honestly to the user
Follow-ups reuse the critic rather than bypassing it; no prior notes stops with no_prior_research
Inference settings tuned per node, effort medium throughout
Memory is vector retrieval with a relevance floor, not a growing prompt
MemoryStore and Embedder are separate seams, guarded by a test on the graph's reach
pgvector/HNSW replaces the O(n) scan and makes recall shared across machines
Migration copies embeddings rather than re-embedding, to avoid confounding recall changes
Spend cap is a routing rule checked between nodes, using state usage
Prices are effective-dated; unpriced models report pricing_unknown rather than zero cost
Failed runs counted in metrics denominator; zero-denominator rates return null
Sessions store completed runs in SQLite, deliberately not LangGraph's checkpointer
One DATABASE_URL switches sessions, metrics, and notes together
Backend swappability enforced by shared behavioural tests and byte-identical metrics assertion
Retries at the node boundary, only for retryable statuses, with recorded attempts and injectable sleep/rng
No API clients or DDL constructed at import time, so the service boots degraded and self-heals
Streams emit exactly one terminal event, including an in-band error event
Offline evals grade the pipeline only; the caveat is printed under every offline run
Eval judge runs on Opus 5 against a Sonnet 5 pipeline and returns a structured verdict
MAX_ITERATIONS derived from MAX_REVISIONS so the backstop stays above the cap
Web server isolated in a [service] extra; src layout keeps tests and evals out of the image
